title: Complete Checkout with Saved Payment Method
description: As a returning customer, I want to complete the checkout process using a saved payment method so that I can purchase products quickly without re-entering card details.
acceptance_criteria: Given a logged-in user with a saved payment method, when they proceed to checkout, then their saved card is pre-selected.
Given the saved card is selected, when the user confirms the order, then payment is processed and an order confirmation is shown.
Given the payment fails, when the user retries, then the cart is not cleared and the user can select a different payment method.
Given the order is confirmed, when the checkout completes, then the user receives an email confirmation within 2 minutes.

title: Apply Discount Coupon at Checkout
description: As a customer, I want to apply a discount coupon code during checkout so that I can receive the advertised discount on my purchase.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid coupon code, when the user enters it at checkout, then the discount is applied and the total is updated.
Given an expired coupon code, when the user enters it, then an error message is shown and the total is not changed.
Given a coupon with a minimum order value, when the cart total is below the minimum, then the coupon is rejected with a clear message.
Given a coupon is applied, when the user removes an item causing the total to drop below the minimum, then the coupon is automatically removed.

title: Guest Checkout Without Account
description: As a new visitor, I want to complete a purchase without creating an account so that I can buy products quickly without registration overhead.
acceptance_criteria: Given an unauthenticated user, when they add an item to cart and proceed to checkout, then they are offered a guest checkout option.
Given guest checkout is selected, when the user provides email, shipping address, and payment details, then the order is placed successfully.
Given the order is placed as a guest, when checkout completes, then a confirmation email is sent to the provided email address.
Given a guest checkout, when the order is complete, then the user is offered the option to create an account.

title: Multi-factor Authentication Login
description: As a security-conscious user, I want to use multi-factor authentication when logging in so that my account is protected from unauthorised access.
acceptance_criteria: Given MFA is enabled, when a user logs in with valid credentials, then they are prompted for a one-time code.
Given the correct OTP is entered, when submitted, then the user is authenticated and redirected to the dashboard.
Given an incorrect OTP is entered, when submitted, then an error message is shown and the user may retry up to 3 times.
Given 3 failed OTP attempts, when the limit is reached, then the account is temporarily locked and the user is notified by email.

title: View and Filter Order History
description: As a registered customer, I want to view and filter my order history so that I can find past orders and track their status.
acceptance_criteria: Given a logged-in user, when they navigate to order history, then all past orders are displayed in reverse chronological order.
Given orders are displayed, when the user filters by status (Delivered, Pending, Cancelled), then only matching orders are shown.
Given a specific order, when the user clicks it, then they see the full order detail including items, prices, and delivery status.
Given more than 10 orders, when viewing the list, then pagination is provided with 10 orders per page.

title: Advanced Product Search with Filters
description: As a shopper, I want to search for products using keyword and filter by category, price range, and rating so that I can quickly find what I am looking for.
acceptance_criteria: Given a search term, when the user submits the search, then results are returned within 1 second.
Given search results, when the user applies a price range filter, then only products within that range are shown.
Given search results, when the user sorts by rating, then the highest-rated products appear first.
Given a search with zero results, when shown, then a helpful message and alternative suggestions are displayed.

title: Product Detail Page with Stock Indicator
description: As a shopper, I want to see real-time stock availability on the product detail page so that I know whether the item is available before adding it to my cart.
acceptance_criteria: Given a product with stock > 10, when viewing the product page, then 'In Stock' is displayed.
Given a product with stock between 1 and 10, when viewing the page, then 'Only X left' is shown.
Given a product with stock 0, when viewing the page, then 'Out of Stock' is shown and Add to Cart is disabled.
Given stock changes while the user is viewing, when the page is refreshed, then the latest stock level is shown.
